nodes.title: START HERE
code:
GROVE QUEST - LITE
JOYSTICK 2: MOVE. FIRE: SHOOT. UP AT DOOR: CHANGE ROOM.
EDIT: FRONT_END in Bitmap editor; TILES, ACTORS and WORLD in asset editors. MUSIC_AND_SFX has a looping tune and action sound. STATUS is the top HUD.
DOOR_LINKS bytes: source room, tile tag, destination room, spawn X, spawn Y. $FF ends table. Door tile is 130. Rooms 0 and 1.
RAM: $2000 charset; $2800 six sprite frames; $2B00 door table; $3000 world plane; $4000 title bitmap; $6000 title colours; $7000 second room; $8000 engine; $C000 game state.
STATE $C000: player X,Y, enemy X,Y, shot active,X,Y, room,lives,invulnerability,jump,fire latch,input,frame,enemy direction,score.
A small editable starter: one enemy, three lives, repeatable play. Game rules use ordinary opcode and label nodes; no CODE blocks.
